hero_subhead: Faulty wiring, broken sockets, or a full rewire? We diagnose and fix electrical faults fast, with no hidden charges.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, or flickering lights? We respond quickly to get your home safe and lit again. Same-day call-out available.

services.title: Socket and Switch Installation
services.desc: Add new sockets, relocate outlets, or install modern switches throughout your home. All work tested and certified.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Older homes with aging wiring? We replace outdated circuits with modern safe systems, reducing fire risk and improving reliability.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace your fuse box with a modern circuit breaker unit. Safer, more reliable, and often reduces insurance premiums.

services.title: Fault Finding and Testing
services.desc: Electrical problems that baffle others? We use diagnostic equipment to pinpoint faults quickly, so we fix the root cause, not just symptoms.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Office rewires, new installations, and regular safety inspections for small businesses and retail premises across Leicester.

about_pullquote: I wire homes the way I'd wire my own—safely, fairly, and with no surprises.
about_para_1: All Rooms Electrics has served Leicester homeowners and businesses for 18 years. We started because local electricians either charged extortionately or cut corners. Our approach is simple: honest diagnosis, transparent pricing, and work that lasts. Every job is tested to the highest standards and certified in full.
about_para_2: You'll find us on call when others aren't, and we turn up on time with the right tools. We specialise in older properties where the wiring has deteriorated, and we're equally at home upgrading modern homes or rewiring commercial spaces. Most of our new customers come through word of mouth—a sign that we get the job right the first time.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homes Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a dodgy socket that kept tripping the breaker. Called around and everyone wanted £80 just to look at it. Paul came out, diagnosed a fault in the wiring behind the wall, sorted it properly, and charged a fair price. No messing about. Top job.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Rewired our 1930s semi. Big job, could have taken weeks and a fortune. Paul was organised, clean, and finished on time. All tested and certified. House feels safer now. Really pleased.
reviews.author: Catherine W.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 6pm on a Sunday. Most electricians don't answer. Paul did. He arrived within an hour, replaced a burnt-out breaker, and the house was back to normal. Fair charge too. Will definitely call him again.
reviews.author: David K.
